entities.summary: Abdulkadir Abdulla Abdullayev is an Azerbaijani heavyweight amateur boxer. In 2015 he won a gold medal at the European Games and a bronze at the World Championships. He competed at the 2016 Olympics, but was eliminated in the second bout.
